parts.text:
Build an app called "Side Project Tinder."

Developers swipe through their own abandoned GitHub projects like Tinder. Every project is presented as a profile with its idea, tech stack, maturity, market potential, and "personality."

Users can swipe to Delete, Archive, Revive, Showcase, or Build. The AI explains every recommendation and can also suggest unexpected project combinations, startup opportunities, or portfolio improvements. The goal is to make cleaning and rediscovering old projects fun, addictive, and genuinely useful.

I've built [Side Project Tinder](/a/a3f2f2fd-ea89-4868-bdc5-e4592c2dba45)!

### What You Can Do
* **🎴 Tinder-Style Swipe Deck**: Swipe cards left or right, or use quick action buttons to classify abandoned side projects into 5 clear pathways:
  * ❌ **Delete** (Graveyard)
  * 📦 **Archive** (Cold Storage)
  * ⚡ **Revive** (High Priority)
  * 🌟 **Showcase** (Portfolio Highlight)
  * 🔨 **Build** (Active Development)
* **🎭 Personality Profiles & Market Potential**: Each project features a humorous "Personality Profile" (e.g., *"The Rust Rewrite That Never Ended"*), tech badges, maturity levels, and market score meters.
* **🤖 AI Project Coach**: Click **Ask AI Coach** on any project for direct advice on whether to revive or bury it, a 1-weekend revival recipe, and portfolio strategy.
* **🔮 AI Mashup Lab**: Select any two abandoned projects to fuse them into an unexpected new startup idea or open-source product using AI.
* **⚡ Active & Graveyard Dashboards**: Track all decisions with persistent storage, resurrect or return projects to the deck, and export your action plan as Markdown.
* **➕ Add Projects**: Insert your own custom side projects into the deck anytime.

### What's New
* **🐙 GitHub Import Bar**: Enter any GitHub username (e.g. `torvalds`, `sindresorhus`, `octocat`) or repository name/URL (e.g. `facebook/react`, `shadcn/ui`).
* **⚡ Automated AI Analysis**: Clicking **⚡ Import Repos** or clicking any quick preset chip automatically fetches public repositories, generates market potential scores, tech stack tags, maturity stages, and humorous personality profiles, loading them straight into your Tinder swipe deck!

I've updated [Side Project Tinder](/a/a3f2f2fd-ea89-4868-bdc5-e4592c2dba45) with both web search/scraping and JSON import options!

### Key Features Added
* **🌐 Web Search & Scrape Repo**: Enter any GitHub username, repository name, or GitHub URL in the search bar. The app leverages automated Playwright web browsing and AI analysis to scrape and parse the GitHub page, creating detailed project cards.
* **📋 Paste Repo JSON**: Click **📋 Paste JSON** to open a dedicated modal where you can paste raw JSON output from GitHub's API (`/repos/owner/repo` or `/users/owner/repos`) or custom JSON arrays. The app automatically maps repository fields (`name`, `description`, `stargazers_count`, `language`, `topics`) straight into your Tinder swipe stack!
